requirements.name: 乱斗开始
requirements.prompt: boxing ring bell rung twice followed by a rising stadium crowd roar, cartoon arcade fighting game

requirements.name: 文化连携发动
requirements.prompt: short comedic brass fanfare sting with a cymbal hit, playful arcade game power-up cue
requirements.notes: 文化连携（四字文化队）发动

requirements.name: 宿敌对决
requirements.prompt: deep war horn blast over two heavy taiko drum hits, epic but slightly comedic, arcade sports intro

requirements.name: 纸箱落地
requirements.prompt: empty cardboard box dropping onto grass and a football bouncing off it, hollow papery thump
requirements.notes: 纸箱障碍出现 / 球撞纸箱

requirements.name: 连携翻车
requirements.prompt: cartoon slip and fall, rubbery boing and a small crash, then a short sad trombone wah
requirements.notes: 文化连携失误（摔倒、撞人、踢飞）

requirements.name: 一脚连传
requirements.prompt: three quick football taps in a row with light whooshes between them, crisp and rhythmic

requirements.name: 瞬间换位
requirements.prompt: quick cartoon smoke poof with a tiny magical shimmer, stage magician trick
requirements.notes: 队友换位 / 打乱对手站位
